body.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Reconstruct ONE clean continuous dark antique wooden UI panel surface from the supplied small material sample. The sample is only the empty wood face of an approved Russian fairy-tale game panel. Match its very dark brown and charcoal walnut palette, restrained warm highlights, broad horizontal grain and painterly realism. Expand this exact material into a clean full square surface with natural non-repeating grain. Flat front-facing texture, consistent scale and subdued illumination, no perspective or bevel. Keep the wood dark enough for pale gold text to remain readable. No golden ornament, no border, no text, no symbols, no icons, no buttons, no seam grid, no mirrored repeated patches, no scenery, no character, no vignette. Full bleed opaque wood material only. This is a material layer placed behind independent live controls, not a page mockup.
